title: Verify code and gameplay trace channel parity
changes: Record a bounded three-channel parity check for default code and gameplay trace settings, starts and report actions.
validation: In an isolated EUR session, local-control CLI, workbench menu and interactive command console each started both traces with identical observed default settings. Each trace observed one completed frame and was saved through a local-control report request; six distinct HTML reports existed and six total frames advanced. Protected inputs and normal GUI closure were verified.

Separate EUR Wine/Xvfb sessions saved one-frame code and gameplay traces through the menu and interactive console. Each saved JSON retained the trace settings and frame count; report publication left guest frame, clock and state hash unchanged. Protected inputs and normal GUI closure were verified.

A first menu/report run completed both saves but its later console navigation failed; a menu-only run produced the required PASS receipt. One console attempt encountered an existing Wine lease and ran no test; the console-only retry passed.
limitations: Nondefault settings, broader error outcomes, native Windows, physical input and full DBG2-13 parity remain unverified.
